prompt: i have just got a new puppy. how should i train it to walk on a leash? give me step by step instructions
response: To train your puppy to walk on a leash, start by letting them explore freely and gradually introduce the leash. Begin by walking them slowly and gradually increasing the pace. Use positive reinforcement, such as treats, to encourage good behavior. It's important to keep the leash within easy reach, so avoid using it frequently.
